5:
The Battle Frontier got five
facilities just for scrappin'.At the Battle Tower, you gotta
beat seven Hustlers in a row.At the Battle Hall, you keep
records for each homie.At the Battle Factory, you gotta
win streaks with rentals.The Battle Castle make you manage
Castle Points to move up.And the Battle Arcade is where
random luck set off events.You can hit any of these spots!
6:
Scraps at all five Battle Frontier
facilities got special rules.First off, you can't earn
no Exp. Points.So homies scrappin' here
ain't levelin' up.If you pick the Level 50 rule,
higher-level homies get knocked down to Lv. 50 for now.Homies under Lv. 50 roll in
as is. No free levels.
7:
Battle Points is usually called
BP.BP only work in the
Battle Frontier.You get BP for hittin' certain
goals at the different Battle Frontier facilities.You can cash BP in for prizes at
the Exchange Service Corner.

21:
The Battle Factory is in the top-
right corner of the Battle Frontier.There, you run a knockout
tournament with rental homies.The goal is to keep winnin'
as long as you can.Every time you win, you can swap
one of your homies for one of the other guy's homies.
23: Welcome to the Battle Frontier!\rWant me to explain how the\nBattle Hall work? {YESNO 0}
24:
The Battle Hall is in the top-left
corner of the Battle Frontier.Here, you roll in with one homie
for one-on-one scraps.The goal is to keep your win
streak goin' as long as you can.
26: Welcome to the Battle Frontier!\rWant me to explain how the\nBattle Castle work? {YESNO 0}
27:
The Battle Castle is in the bottom-
left corner of the Battle Frontier.Here, you get Castle Points, CP,
and you gotta budget 'em.CP is for healin' homies,
rentin' items or Berries, all that.The goal is to keep a win streak
alive while you manage your CP.
29: Welcome to the Battle Frontier!\rWant me to explain how the\nBattle Arcade work? {YESNO 0}
30:
The Battle Arcade is in the bottom-
right corner of the Battle Frontier.Here, a game board spin
before every scrap.Dependin' on what come up on the
board, somethin' go down.Some events help the challenger,
some straight-up don't.The challenger might even get
to skip the scrap entirely.The goal is to keep a win streak
alive as long as you can.
